text: The purpose of this report is to advise the Board of Health of the impact of the end of the lease for the Toronto Public Health (TPH) dental clinic at 235 Danforth Avenue on April 30, 2022. The clinic's last day of operations will be March 31, 2022. 235 Danforth Avenue clinic utilization data supports directing clients to obtain services at the nearby TPH dental clinic at 791 Queen Street East.
The Board of Health: 1. Received the report (October 8, 2021) from the Medical Officer of Health for information.
